records.title: Beyond Binary Edits Robust Multimodal Knowledge Editing with Adversarial Subspace Alignment
records.reason: The paper studies intrinsic multimodal knowledge editing (latent adversarial variants and low-rank alignment), with experiments on edit reliability/generalization. It does not propose an inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, quantization, or serving optimization; the linked MoE-LLaVA relation is only an MLLM application/architecture context.

records.title: Memento: Personalized RAG-Style Long-Retention Data Scaling for META Ads Recommendation
records.reason: The full text describes long-history ad recommendation infrastructure using retrieval, INT8 storage, and asynchronous serving, with low-latency production requests. It is a recommender system rather than an LLM inference/serving method; the Big Bird long-sequence lineage and use of RAG-style retrieval leave a possible but weak transfer connection.
